# netbox_inventory_item_templates (Data Source)

Lists NetBox inventory item template objects (`/api/dcim/inventory-item-templates/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_inventory_item_templates" "all" {}

data "netbox_inventory_item_templates" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "inventory_item_templates_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_inventory_item_templates.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/inventory-item-templates/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `component_id` (Number) Component Id.
- `component_type` (String) Component Type.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `depth` (Number) Depth.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the Manufacturer (`netbox_manufacturer`).
- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the Inventory Item Template (`netbox_inventory_item_template`).
- `part_id` (String) Manufacturer-assigned part identifier. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the Inventory Item Role (`netbox_inventory_item_role`).
- `url` (String) Url.
